title: OWASP SQL Injection Prevention Cheat Sheet

chunks.title: OWASP SQL Injection Prevention Cheat Sheet
chunks.excerpt: SQL injection occurs when untrusted data becomes part of a query's SQL syntax.

chunks.title: OWASP SQL Injection Prevention Cheat Sheet
chunks.section: Defense Option 1: Prepared Statements (with Parameterized Queries)
chunks.excerpt: Define the SQL structure separately from its data values, then bind those values through the database API.

chunks.title: OWASP SQL Injection Prevention Cheat Sheet
chunks.section: Defense Option 1: Prepared Statements (with Parameterized Queries)
chunks.excerpt: Concatenating untrusted values into the query before preparing it defeats this protection.

chunks.title: OWASP SQL Injection Prevention Cheat Sheet
chunks.excerpt: To minimize the potential damage of a successful SQL injection attack, you should minimize the privileges assigned to every database account in your environment.
